title: Aureline M5 environment-fingerprint-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the environment-fingerprint-card family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). An environment fingerprint card names which slice of the environment it captures and how completely it was captured so a card never leaves the environment behind a result implicit and never hides a drifted or missing capture. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
